title: Beta funnel copy is best-practice conversion copy, and the funnel steps wear the dark Stage orbs and gradients

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const s=r('lib/onboarding/funnel-script.ts'),i=r('app/join/(induction)/induction.tsx'),c=r('app/themes/frequency/site-funnel.css');const bad=[];if(/Write the /.test(s))bad.push('the default funnel copy is still writing prompts');if(!i.includes('jx-panel iw-stage')||!i.includes('className=\"rings\"'))bad.push('the induction steps carry no orbs');if(!c.includes('.iw-stage, [data-design'))bad.push('no stage gradient');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1280: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Owner 2026-10-22: rewrite the beta sequences with best-practice content and push more of the dark theme with gradients and orbs. The code default (VERA in lib/onboarding/funnel-script.ts, which every new funnel clones) was fill-in writing prompts; it is now real copy: a founder promise with a clear free offer and a single action, a reason for each ask, the December 1 North County San Diego opening, and a close that names what happens next. Every induction step now carries the kit's .jx-panel (the site FX draws the Join sphere and halos), the .rings orbs and a two-point Stage gradient from tokens. The stored rows (sequence_overrides beta-default and beta-onboarding) are updated by an owner SQL paste with the same copy. Niche rows keep their own feature cards (the Niche thread's).
